t:
Arrange the events in sequence of which happened first to the last.

I. Nationalisation of non life insurance industry
II. Nationalisation of life insurance industry
III. Introduction of CGHS scheme
e: Correct answer: III, II and I (from the IC27 question bank).

t: What is the minimum number of days for which treatment needs to be taken at home to be covered under the domiciliary hospitalisation provision of health insurance policies?
e: Correct answer: 3 days (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
The applicant details section of a health insurance policy usually covers which of the following questions?

I. Occupation
II. PAN details
III. Details of the hospitalisation at present or in the past
e: Correct answer: I, II, and III (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Frauds related to inflation of medical bills generally happen at:-

I. Proposal and policy stage
II.Claim settlement stage
III. Frauds during the contractual period
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC27 question bank).

t: All of the following are not covered by any of the hospitalisation insurance policies EXCEPT:-
e: Correct answer: Maternity (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Which of the following frauds take place at the proposal and policy stage?

I. Cash defalcations
II. Providing erroneous address to claim benefit
III. Address and contact details changed
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Health insurance are usually reinsured using which reinsurance structure?

I. Quota share
II. Surplus share
III. Stop loss
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Mr. B was diagnosed with AIDS. He was admitted in the hospital for 12 days. Which of the following expenses shall be covered by the hospital indemnity policy?
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: No expenses will be reimbursed (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Which of the following parameters in analysis can show the number of people covered and the premium for different group sizes for both group and individual policies?
e: Correct answer: Group size distribution (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Claims which are high frequency but low severity ____________________.
o: Would require a quota share reinsurance structure
Would require a surplus share reinsurance structur
Would require a quota share or a surplus share rei
Would require a stop loss type of reinsurance structure
e: Correct answer: Would require a stop loss type of reinsurance structure (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Which of the following products are usually reinsured using a portfolio approach?

I. Indemnity health insurance
II. Fixed benefits cover
III. Critical Illness cover
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC27 question bank).

t: In health insurance business, it is critical to strike an appropriate balance between risk and business. This process of balancing is done by _________________.
e: Correct answer: Underwriter (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Vijay Vyas needs to travel to US on 15<SUP>th</SUP> of next month. Suggest a suitable health insurance product for him.
e: Correct answer: Overseas Medical Insurance plan / ?????? ???????? (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Which of the following statement best describes "Social reinsurance"?
o: The reinsurance contract is proportional to the or
A form of pro rata reinsurance indemnifying the ce
A form of reinsurance that indemnifies the ceding
A structure where the reinsurer designs the entire
A structure  in which NGOs play the role of the distributor and "outsource" the design and administration of the entire insurance product to an insurance company who effectively acts as a reinsurer
e: Correct answer: A structure  in which NGOs play the role of the distributor and "outsource" the design and administration of the entire insurance product to an insurance company who effectively acts as a reinsurer (from the IC27 question bank).

t: X applies for a health insurance policy from ABC ltd.  X was required to fill a detailed questionnaire but no health check-up was done.  Which underwriting method was used in this case?
e: Correct answer: Non medical underwriting (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Mr. A works in a Company in Japan that employs around 800 employees. Name the health insurance program under which he shall be covered.
e: Correct answer: Society Managed Health Insurance Plans (from the IC27 question bank).

t: If X wishes to resolve a dispute seeking compensation worth Rs. 21 lakh from ABC insurance company, then he should approach the  ______________.
e: Correct answer: State Commission (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Age distribution analysis is used to

I. Study the percentage share of each of the age categories for each policy year
II. Understand the customer profile changes from year to year in different age bands
III. Understand the change in claims cost from year to year
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Mr. B works in a Company in Japan that employs around 400 employees. Name the health insurance program under which he shall be covered.
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: Government managed health insurance (from the IC27 question bank).

t: All of the following are submitted as Standard Age proof EXCEPT:-
e: Correct answer: Ration card (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Which was the first standardised health insurance product to be launched in the Indian market?
e: Correct answer: Mediclaim (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Explain what is "Fonasa".
e: Correct answer: National Health Fund of Chile (from the IC27 question bank).

t: If the complainant is looking for adjudication in respect of claims, then he cannot approach ___________________.
e: Correct answer: Grievance redressal cell of IRDAI (from the IC27 question bank).

t: In Japan the employees who are working with small employers with less than 700 employees and their dependents are automatically enrolled under a which Government operated program?
e: Correct answer: Small business national health plan (from the IC27 question bank).

t: If X wishes to resolve a dispute seeking compensation worth Rs 15 lakh from ABC insurance company, then he should approach the ______________.
e: Correct answer: District Forum / ???? ??? (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is a human interface / process improvisation technique for detection of frauds in insurance sector?

I. Propensity Modeling
II. Fraud management philosophy and policy
III. RAG Analysis
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is/are submitted as non-standard age proof?

I. School certificate
II. Voter ID
III. Ration card
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Identify the correct full form of NRHM in the context of healthcare system in India.
e: Correct answer: National Rural Heath Mission (from the IC27 question bank).

t: In which year was the ESI Act enacted?
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: 1948 (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are the role of Grievance redressal Cell?

I. Adjudicate complaints
II. Provide speedy resolution to complaints by taking up complaints against respective insurance companies
III. Act as judicial channel for grievance redressal
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC27 question bank).

t: X has taken a health insurance policy from ABC Ltd. As per the insurance contract, the amount will be paid by the insurer on the occurrence of a certain event  as predetermined in the insurance policy and will not be related to the actual expenditure incurred. What do you infer from this information?
o: X has taken a health cover on indemnity basis
X has taken insurance coverage on benefit basis
X has taken a Combi product based on indemnity and
X has taken a Top Up cover
X has taken a hospitalisation cover
e: Correct answer: X has taken insurance coverage on benefit basis (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement

I. Indemnity health insurance pays for the actual cost of the health episode.
II. Indemnity health insurance product line is generically given the name of "Medi-claim".
III. Indemnity health insurance covers have an average sum insured of Rs. 100,000.
e: Correct answer: I,II and III (from the IC27 question bank).

t: The data with regard to Date of admission and discharge from hospital is recorded in _______________.
e: Correct answer: Claims data table (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Claim analysis by hospitals helps in:-

I. Illustrating the amount paid to each hospital on the basis of ICD diagnosis codes
II. Determining the average and total amount paid to each hospital for various ICD codes
III. Pointing out the high cost hospitals and renegotiating terms with them
e: Correct answer: I,II and III (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Who among the following will be considered as sub standard risk?
e: Correct answer: Driver (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement.

I. Critical illness benefit products are available as standalone products or as riders to life and non-life policies
II. Critical illness benefit products, are available as a component of a packaged health insurance product.
o: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
Either I or II can be true
e: Correct answer: Both I and II are true (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Under IRDAI's 2024 norms, a surveyor must be appointed within what time of a claim intimation?
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). Appointment within 24 hours; survey report within 15 days; insurer's decision within 7 days of the report.

t: X has taken a Mediclaim policy of Rs. 2.5 lakhs from ABC Insurance Ltd. The policy  states that if in case of any hospitalisation, the company will cover room charges only up to 1% of the sum assured for a day. What amount as room charges will be paid by insurance companies to X in event of hospitalisation?
e: Correct answer: Rs 2500 a day (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Mr. C is a resident of Thailand and a Government employee. Under which health insurance scheme shall he be covered?
o: The Civil Servant Medical Benefits Schemes
The Government Employees medical care system
e: Correct answer: The Civil Servant Medical Benefits Schemes (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Health insurance is governed by:-

I. Principle of Uberrima fides
II. Principle of indemnity
III. Principle of insurable interest
e: Correct answer: I,II and III (from the IC27 question bank).

t: X applies for a health insurance policy from ABC Insurance Company. The underwriter categorises X as Standard risk.  What decision will be taken by Underwriter with regard to acceptance of risk?
o: Postpone the cover for stipulated period
e: Correct answer: Accept risk at standard rates (from the IC27 question bank).

t: The Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY) is regulated by which governmental body?
o: Ministry of Rural and Urban Development
e: Correct answer: Ministry of Labour (from the IC27 question bank).

Reinsurance structure helps in:-

e: Correct answer: I,II and III (from the IC27 question bank).

t: For health insurance, the maximum time an insurer may take to decide a cashless authorisation request under the 2024 master circular is:
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). Cashless authorisation within 1 hour of request; final discharge authorisation within 3 hours.

t:
Claims analysis can show:-

II. The corresponding number of claims for different years
III. The components of claim costs

t: _________________ have emerged as the custodians for enrolment and claims data for insurance companies.
e: Correct answer: TPAs (from the IC27 question bank).

In which of the following cases, financial documents needs to be taken from proposer?

I. In cases of high sum assured coverage
II. Where the stated income and occupation vis a vis the coverage sought shows a mismatch
III. If proposer fails to submit standard age proof
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC27 question bank).

o: Introducing clause of waiting period before any benefit commences
